commands.name: Verify committed versions are in lockstep
Install local archive
commands.run:
archive="release-assets/mangostudio-${DRY_RUN_VERSION}-linux-x64.tar.gz"
bash scripts/install/install.sh --local "$archive"
actual="$("${MANGOSTUDIO_BIN_DIR}/mangostudio" --version)"
if [ "$actual" != "$DRY_RUN_VERSION" ]; then
  echo "Expected ${DRY_RUN_VERSION}, got ${actual}"
  exit 1
fi

commands.name: Verify install layout
commands.run:
set -euo pipefail
current_target="$(readlink "${MANGOSTUDIO_INSTALL_DIR}/current")"
if [ "$current_target" != "$DRY_RUN_VERSION" ]; then
  echo "Expected current -> ${DRY_RUN_VERSION}, got ${current_target}"
  exit 1
fi
bin_target="$(readlink "${MANGOSTUDIO_BIN_DIR}/mangostudio")"
if [ "$bin_target" != "${MANGOSTUDIO_INSTALL_DIR}/current/mangostudio" ]; then
  echo "Expected the bin link to go through current/, got ${bin_target}"
  exit 1
fi

commands.name: Verify the installed binary recognises its own install
commands.run:
set -euo pipefail
report="$("${MANGOSTUDIO_BIN_DIR}/mangostudio" upgrade --check --json)"
echo "$report"
manager="$(printf '%s' "$report" | jq -r '.installedVia.manager')"
if [ "$manager" != "self-managed" ]; then
  echo "Expected installedVia.manager self-managed, got ${manager}"
  exit 1
fi

commands.name: Verify the embedded installers match the committed scripts
commands.run:
set -euo pipefail
"${MANGOSTUDIO_BIN_DIR}/mangostudio" __installer sh | diff - scripts/install/install.sh
"${MANGOSTUDIO_BIN_DIR}/mangostudio" __installer ps1 | diff - scripts/install/install.ps1

commands.name: Verify install lifecycle (--use, --prune, --uninstall)
commands.run:
set -euo pipefail
bash scripts/install/install.sh --use "$DRY_RUN_VERSION"
if [ "$(readlink "${MANGOSTUDIO_INSTALL_DIR}/current")" != "$DRY_RUN_VERSION" ]; then
  echo "--use did not leave current pointing at ${DRY_RUN_VERSION}"
  exit 1
fi

mkdir -p "${MANGOSTUDIO_INSTALL_DIR}/0.0.0-old"
bash scripts/install/install.sh --prune
if [ -d "${MANGOSTUDIO_INSTALL_DIR}/0.0.0-old" ]; then
  echo "--prune left a stale version directory behind"
  exit 1
fi
if [ ! -d "${MANGOSTUDIO_INSTALL_DIR}/${DRY_RUN_VERSION}" ]; then
  echo "--prune removed the current version"
  exit 1
fi

bash scripts/install/install.sh --uninstall
if [ -e "$MANGOSTUDIO_INSTALL_DIR" ]; then
  echo "--uninstall left the install root behind"
  exit 1
fi

commands.name: Render distribution manifests
commands.run:
sums="$RUNNER_TEMP/SHA256SUMS"
cp release-assets/SHA256SUMS "$sums"

bun ./scripts/release/fill-dry-run-checksums.ts \
  --version "$DRY_RUN_VERSION" \
  --sums "$sums"

bun ./scripts/release/update-homebrew.ts \
  --version "$DRY_RUN_VERSION" \
  --sums "$sums" \
  --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/mangostudio.rb"
grep -q "version \"${DRY_RUN_VERSION}\"" "$RUNNER_TEMP/mangostudio.rb"
grep -Eq 'sha256 "[0-9a-f]{64}"' "$RUNNER_TEMP/mangostudio.rb"

bun ./scripts/release/update-scoop.ts \
  --version "$DRY_RUN_VERSION" \
  --sums "$sums" \
  --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/mangostudio.json"
bun -e 'JSON.parse(await Bun.file(process.argv.at(-1)).text())' "$RUNNER_TEMP/mangostudio.json"

commands.name: Stage Bookworm Docker context from release assets
Build Bookworm Docker image
commands.run:
docker build \
  --platform linux/amd64 \
  --build-arg VERSION="${DRY_RUN_VERSION}" \
  -f Dockerfile \
  -t mangostudio:dryrun-bookworm-amd64 .

commands.name: Verify install layout
commands.run:
$expected = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath("$env:MANGOSTUDIO_INSTALL_DIR\$env:DRY_RUN_VERSION")

# The shim names the version directory relative to itself when that
# path is ascii ("%~dp0..\<version>"), because cmd.exe decodes a .cmd
# in the console code page but resolves %~dp0 itself in Unicode.
# Resolve it the way cmd does before comparing, and read it as Oem —
# the encoding Write-Shim writes.
$cmdPath = "$env:MANGOSTUDIO_BIN_DIR\mangostudio.cmd"
$content = Get-Content -Raw -Encoding Oem $cmdPath
$match = [regex]::Match($content, '"([^"]+)\\mangostudio\.exe"\s+%\*')
if (-not $match.Success) {
  Write-Error "mangostudio.cmd does not run a quoted mangostudio.exe: $content"
  exit 1
}
$target = $match.Groups[1].Value
if ($target.StartsWith('%~dp0')) {
  $target = Join-Path (Split-Path $cmdPath -Parent) $target.Substring(5)
}
$target = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($target)
if ($target -ne $expected) {
  Write-Error "mangostudio.cmd points at $target, expected $expected"
  exit 1
}

# hub-executable.ts resolves a detached restart and a service unit
# through this junction, so a missing or stale one silently re-execs
# the version an upgrade just replaced.
$current = Get-Item "$env:MANGOSTUDIO_INSTALL_DIR\current" -Force
if ($current.LinkType -ne 'Junction') {
  Write-Error "current is $($current.LinkType), expected Junction"
  exit 1
}
$currentTarget = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((@($current.Target)[0]))
if ($currentTarget -ne $expected) {
  Write-Error "current points at $currentTarget, expected $expected"
  exit 1
}
